model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of different language families on the performance of three language models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, and mBERT-B2, and XLM-R2. The horizontal axis represents language families, ordered as IE-Indic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Three sets of bars are presented for each language family, corresponding to the three models. The mBERT-L2 bars are colored light green, the XLM-L2 bars are light blue, the mBERT-B2 bars are red, and the XLM-R2 bars are gray. Error bars are shown for each bar, representing the standard deviation. The shortest bars in the chart have approximate values of 0, while the tallest bars reach approximately 28. The bars are grouped by language family, with each model represented by a separate bar within each group. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard error bars.
